page.content:
Reddas, real name Foris Zecht, is a guest character in Final Fantasy XII. A pirate of both the land and sky, he is the ruler of Balfonheim, cursed with memories of his terrible actions.

page.overview:
Who is Reddas?

Reddas joins the party as a guest in Final Fantasy XII after the party acquires the Treaty-Blade. He wields the Chirijiraden and Ninja Knife, and is equipped with a Dragon Mail, Dragon Helm, and a Battle Harness (original) or Steel Gorget (Zodiac). Reddas's weapons, the Chirijiraden and the Ninja Knife, do not match the appearance of their names, and have their designs based on different weapons: his longer sword resembles a Kora , a sword of Nepalese origin, and his shorter sword of a Kopis or a Khukuri.

In the original PlayStation 2 version, he has the augments Last Stand, Adrenaline, Counter, Parry, and Null Evade. He knows Telekinesis.

In the Zodiac versions, Reddas can cast Arise and Holy, and use the Technicks Stamp, Bonecrusher, Sight Unseeing, and 1000 Needles. He has the augments Adrenaline, Last Stand, Headsman, Martyr, Null Evade, Parry, and Spellbound. He can now attack flying enemies with his normal attack (in the original, he needed to use his Telekinesis).

Reddas is the fastest party member the player has access to alongside Reks and his entry level is calculated by the average of the two highest leveled party members, plus two. Reddas's base Strength is high, and it is augmented by heavy armor, but his HP is low, even for a character that had bought no +HP licenses, and will benefit from Bubble. Reddas's victory pose is to draw both his Chirijiraden and Ninja Knife and swipe them in the air. As a guest, he cannot access the License Board system or use a Quickening.
